segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Hello Mina, this is Bikash from Thali POS. Thanks for booking this call. You mentioned a restaurant in Lalitpur, is that right?

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: Yes, that's right. We're replacing our old billing app, and I have a few questions before we decide.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Sure, go ahead.

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: First, if the internet goes down during lunch, does billing still work?

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Yes. Billing keeps working offline and syncs when the connection comes back.

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: Good. Second, do you send kitchen order tickets to the kitchen printer?

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Yes, kitchen order tickets are included in the Standard plan, so the kitchen gets orders straight from the counter.

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: Okay. Is there a free trial before we pay anything?

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Yes, there is a 14-day free trial on both plans, so you can test it in your own outlet first.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Our pricing: the Standard plan is NPR 2,000 per month per outlet, billed yearly.

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: Hmm, that's still a lot for one small cafe. We're not sure we need that much.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: I understand. Setup takes about one day per outlet, so it's quick to get going.

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: Okay, that's good to know.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: How many outlets and billing counters do you have? That decides which plan fits.

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: One outlet and two billing counters, and we might add a third counter later.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Then I'll email you the trial link today, so your team can start this week.

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: Sounds good. Please send it to my email.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Our trainer will visit sometime next week to walk your staff through billing.

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: Okay. I'll talk to my partner and confirm by Saturday.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Dhanyabad, Mina ji. I'll call you on Monday at 11 am to check on your decision.
